overview: Each episode features two scorching standoffs between a pair of razor-sharp comics looking to be crowned battle victor by the distinguished panel of judges. Ready to prove they can deliver the superior jabs, the rules are simple – come prepared with original material, and contact should be of the verbal variety only.

overview: The first-hand stories of Europe's most daring art heists, in which Turners, Rembrandts and Munch's The Scream are stolen.

overview: Watch highlights and analysis from all the weekend's Irish Premiership football action.

overview: Pond and Phuwin take on the big world by traveling to new places and trying new activities and food to broaden their horizons.

overview: Part wildlife and part adventure show, follow the escapades of young National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory as he travels the world capturing extraordinary footage of wild animals. Using a combination of technical wizardry, secret fieldcraft and extreme perseverance, he and his team try to overcome the challenges and dangers and get as close as possible to wildlife on its own terms.
title: Epic Adventures with Bertie Gregory

overview: Olivia is a 27-year-old girl in an existential crisis who found herself becoming a responsible adult quickly; raising her twins on her own and keeping a slacker brother out of trouble. An accident opens her eyes to the fact that there is only one life and that, perhaps, it is worth trying to change it in order to realize some of the dreams she had set aside.

overview: Travel-reality, which will open our country from a new exotic side. Presenters Maria Gorban and Alexey Krivenya will compile a guide to non-banal Russian attractions.

overview: A story about prosecutor named Jin Jeong, armed with badness and worthlessness, breaking the sanctuary created by wealth and power. He chooses expediency over the law, trick over the standard, and defect over sincerity. He will provide a sense of exhilaration by punishing corrupt officials who are eating away at this society.

overview: A work depicting the story of a man playing as a grandson to fulfill the last wish of an elderly grandmother who defected from the North.

overview: Fearless: The Inside Story of the AFLW embarks on a raw and emotional journey into the dreams, struggles and triumphs of the groundbreaking AFLW League.
title: Fearless: The Inside Story of the AFLW

overview: A story that happens when a man who receives a message from his dead wife is invited to 'yonder,' an unknown space where he can meet her for the last time. Through various kinds of people facing the world, Yonder created by advances in science and technology, asks about life, death, and eternal happiness.
title: Yonder

overview: The drama tells the story of the relative deprivation we all suffer, the thirst of our stomach aches, and our struggles to soothe our thirsts.
title: Ppalganpungseon

overview: Sergeant Ko Fai completed undercover operations many years ago, and there is always a cloud hanging over him. Ko Fai is reassigned to a police precinct that is Crime Squad Station Sergeant Fong Chi-kiu's territory. While investigating cases, the duo gradually familiarize with each other and develop tacit understanding. Chi-kiu is so dedicated to her job that she has no time for taking care of her family. Her son hangs out with the wrong crowd and gets into trouble. Hotpot restaurant lady boss Lo Sin-man was naive when she was young as she slept with gang boss Law Wai and gave birth to a girl called Lo Siu-po. Fortunately, Ko Fai has always taken care of Sin-man and her daughter. Siu-po becomes a KOL and wants to step into the spotlight by engaging in reckless maneuvers. She gradually descends into the abyss as she reveals how drug dealers go about their business. To protect their loved ones, Ko Fai and Chi-kiu become guardians of the night and are determined to eradicate the villains!
title: Against Darkness

overview: The main character of the series is Ali Haidar. This is not a young man who has his own barbecue and earns a living from this. One day his wife goes missing. Her search was unsuccessful. Ali is left alone with three daughters. He starts thinking about the housekeeper...
title: İkinci Bahar

overview: 20 people, carefully selected from across the UK will be marooned in a tropical location. They will be divided into two tribes, going head-to-head in a range of physical and psychological challenges. Following a number of eliminations that will take place at the iconic tribal council, the tribes will eventually merge before one person takes away a cash prize and proves that they have what it takes to be the Ultimate Survivor.
title: Survivor

overview: Five years ago, schoolgirl Andie Bell was murdered by Sal Singh. Case closed. The police know he did it. Everyone in town knows he did it. But Pippa Fitz-Amobi - our insatiably smart, slightly square heroine - isn't so sure and she's determined to prove it. But if Sal Singh isn't a murderer and the real killer is still out there, how far will they go to keep Pippa from the truth?
title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder

overview: Gastronomic journeys across Russia. Alexander Rembo Pushkov embarks on a tour of the country's cities in search of delicacies and culinary treasures. He will visit markets and restaurants, and visit local households to learn the distinctive cuisines of various Russian regions and the secrets of preparing iconic dishes.
title: Гастротур

overview: Police Major Anastasia Latysheva investigates the murder of the owner of a beauty salon and gets acquainted with the "district" Ekaterina Aminova and a graduate of the law faculty of Moscow State University Lina Smirnova. They help her in this investigation, and after the appointment of Latysheva as the head of the women's "killer" department, Katya and Lina will become his new employees.
title: Угрозы

overview: After 20 years in prison, Innokenty Bochkin is released on an unfair sentence. He is trying to reunite with his grown-up daughter Nastya, who was raised by police lieutenant colonel Vasily Tuchkov, who was forced to resign for refusing to participate in fraud. With the help of fun adventures, Bochkin manages not only to settle in Tuchkov's house, but also to have an affair with his sister Maria. Now Nastya and her two fathers are in for a lot of adventures, because by the will of circumstances Bochkin is forced, by order of the "authority", to steal the painting from the official, who, having learned about this, by all means available to him, tries to send him back to prison before he commits the theft.

overview: The historical series tells about the life of the grandson of Genghis Khan - Kublai Khan. The plot spans several decades and tells about the events that led to the creation of the Yuan dynasty by the great Mongol. After the death of Genghis Khan, his sons Tului and Ogedei entered the struggle for power. Despite the fact that Ogedei becomes Khan, his wife Toregin does not leave anxiety, because she remembers how the Great Genghis Khan singled out among his grandchildren Khubilai, the son of Tului. And even after poisoning her husband's brother, Toregin tries to eliminate Möngke and Khubilai, who are thirsty for revenge for their father, accusing them of organizing an uprising. But thanks to the keen mind of Khubilai and the wisdom of his mother Sorgegtani, the Tului clan was saved.
title: The Legend of Kublai Khan

overview: It is the love triangle romance that takes place when YeJin went to search for her long-time online friend named "Sweet Brick". She does not know if he is the member of her craftwork class named No Woon or the man she often meets by chance named Cha Ieon. ~~Based on the webtoon of OH MY GIRL called "Sometoon x OH MY GIRL" but only partially as it is only Binnie's story which will make it on screen.
title: Sometoon 2020

overview: Gert Verhulst receives four interesting guests every day and asks the questions that concern you.

overview: Savvy saleswomen or devious scammers? Wanna Marchi and Stefania Nobile became the undisputed queens of Italian TV shopping — until they went too far.

overview: In this entertaining super production, the eye-catching visuals of show programs and the excitement of game shows are present at the same time. Amazing talents can show themselves, while a serious cash prize of HUF 10 million is at stake in the studio! Let's find out what they know!

overview: Former soap opera heartthrob Fabián Delmar lives his life in near oblivion after his heyday in the 90s as the lead role in the series "Serás Mía." When Delmar — spurred on by a midlife crisis and the constant degradations of his twilight — sets out to make things right with the regrettable parts of his past, he struggles to find his footing in the modern world.
title: El Galán

overview: Ever wonder if intelligent life existed elsewhere in the Universe? If higher intelligent beings from other worlds do exist? Are they here on Earth? If so, then why? Why don't they make themselves more public? Why the secrecy? In this series Reuben Langdon interviews actual ETs or EDs (Extra Dimensionals) as they call themselves. Each episode focuses on one particular race or "Collective" of Beings and/or an actual being who channels through a particular person or persons. The goal for this series is to receive answers to questions that people have been asking since nearly the beginning of time. Let's find out the big picture perspective of who we are, why we are here, and where we are going.
title: Interviews with Extra Dimensionals

overview: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist unearths the human truths behind some of the most extraordinary cases in con artistry.
title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist

overview: The story of how a movie star from the Republican period Xiang Qin Yu unexpectedly meets a 21st century rookie screenwriter Jin Ayin and how they transcend the constraints of time and space to fall in love.

overview: HBO takes viewers behind the scenes of House of the Dragon. Each episode showcases everything from set construction and digital effects to cast interviews and producer insight.

overview: A once hot-mess, now just a mess, Harriet is about to learn that grief gives zero f*cks about playing by any rules and soon, neither will she.

In addition to showing off their hot rods, each star will open up about life, their careers and more during candid interviews with Austin.
title: Drive!

overview: Na Young Suk PD's ongoing 'New Journey To The West' mini series will be bringing viewers a brand new concept starting on October 23, centered around cast member Super Junior's Kyuhyun! Now, starting on October 23, Super Junior's Kyuhyun will be greeting viewers every Friday nights for 5 minutes through his alter ego, "Drunkard Jo"! It's currently unclear exactly what format "Drunkard Jo"s new mini series will take on, but Na Young Suk PD assured by the end of the teaser above that it will not involve Kyuhyun getting drunk every week, for the most part.
title: Things That Make Me Groove

overview: The world's first TikTok talent show, from song and dance to painting and poetry reading. The participants passed the all-Russian casting, and the best of them will perform on the big stage in front of the jury - Larisa Guzeeva, Dima Bilan and star tiktokers. The winner of the show will receive the title of the main talent of the country and 1,000,000 rubles, and the audience will choose it by voting.
title: ТикТок Талант

overview: Join Jack and his all-star guest list for some Me Time as they discuss coming-of-age in the world of social media, your mental health, and all the adventures in between. Each week, Jack sits down with a different friend and gets into all things mental health.
title: Me Time

overview: When Ruby unwillingly witnesses an explosive secret at Maxton Hall Private School, arrogant millionaire heir James Beaufort is forced to confront the quick-witted scholarship student, much to his chagrin: He is determined to silence Ruby. Their passionate exchange of blows surprisingly ignites a spark ...
title: Maxton Hall

overview: Jiang Le Zhi is a medical school graduate with "Asperger's Syndrome". He has superior intelligence but is not good at expressing. After he came to Songjia Hospital to work in surgery, he did not pay attention to human feelings and proper expressions. In the process of treating patients, he was often misunderstood and complained by patients and family members, causing the hospital committee to question his medical qualifications. Jiang Le Zhi must prove himself during the inspection period before he can continue to work in surgery. During this period, the hospital's dean Lu gave him careful instruction. His colleagues Shen Tong and Ruan Yun Duo also helped him from different aspects. Jiang Le Zhi continued to cultivate his empathy, learn the skills of communicating with others, and give full play to his medical talents, and work with colleagues, rescued patients with different conditions, and finally won the trust of the hospital, officially became an excellent attending doctor, and also gained the love of Ruan Yun Duo.
title: Fantastic Doctors

overview: Maria is a charming party girl who lives at the expense of others. Once in the Emirates, she goes to a nightclub with the wife of a billionaire, the party gets out of hand, and now Maria is facing prison, dangerous people are chasing her, and her accounts are blocked. She has to flee to Russia, but she is not safe at home either - and the girl takes refuge in the walls of the monastery.
title: Монастырь

overview: Two friends go to St. Petersburg on a business trip that will change them forever. Completely different, like ice and fire, the guys equally fall in love with two Petersburgers. Reliable and pedantic Kostya loses his head when he meets the eccentric Ira. And freedom-loving womanizer Sanya first thinks about a real relationship, having met the mysterious cellist Nadia. Love turns the measured lives of Muscovites upside down - and none of them knows what to do with this new feeling.
title: Надвое

overview: A hybrid docu-series exploring the challenges, triumphs, and complexities of adolescence told through ten compelling coming of age stories.
title: Growing Up

overview: A family hiding a shocking secret starts over in Madrid, where new relationships complicate their plans and the past begins to catch up with them.
title: Sagrada familia

overview: Huw Stephens reveals the fascinating history of Welsh music.

overview: The Challenge: Untold History explores the MTV program's conception, evolution and legacy, all while enlisting competitors, producers, media analysts, and famous fans to reveal the true story (sound familiar?) of the greatest competition series on television.
title: The Challenge: Untold History

overview: When a popular boy befriends her, a shy girl's life finally begins to change. This adaptation of the hit manga focuses on friendship, as well as romance.

overview: 16 Days in Berlin is the most detailed documentary about the Battle of Berlin. Follow the battle day by day with this 18-part series.
title: 16 Days in Berlin

overview: Jenny Is a Weapon follows the story of a sheltered Maryland housewife who, at the moment her marriage falls apart, discovers she has special psychic powers and is recruited by a secret government agency where she will have to juggle her broken family and save the world.
title: Jenny Is a Weapon

overview: Cal Hunter and Claire Segeren wanted a flat in Glasgow but accidentally ended up with a crumbling eyesore 35 miles away.
title: Accidental Renovators

overview: Celebrity editions of the music quiz.
title: The Hit List Celebrity Specials

overview: Master Sommelier is more than just a title; it's a badge of honor, and to earn it you need to be a wine expert in mind, body, and spirit – an achievement measured by passing one of the world's most difficult exams. If you can pass it, you'll be let into a club with just over 200 members worldwide and granted access to the most desirable jobs in the entire food and wine industry. Uncorked follows six aspiring master sommeliers from New York, as they prepare for the Court of Masters Sommelier exam.
title: Uncorked

overview: Songkran is a single father and a playboy. Ingdao is a strong girl that takes no crap from anyone, but thanks to her huge mole and unkempt appearance she is often viewed as ugly. Her family owns a large orange farm. Songkran and his father have been eyeing that piece of land, so he decides to make Ingdao's sister, Ingjun, fall in love with him so she willingly signs over the rights to the land her father had given to her. After Songkran obtains proper documents, he leaves her. Ingjun was devastated. Furious, Ingdao wants to take revenge for her younger sister who tried to commit suicide along with getting their land back. But knowing that Songkran will never fall for her in her current state, she is helped by her best friend Moddaeng and transformed into a gorgeous woman named Daopradub.
title: Ku Kaen San Rak

overview: Following the work of legal professionals working throughout the north east of England.
title: Northern Justice

overview: Series explores the Iran hostage crisis of 1979 and the tumultuous history of U.S./Iran relations. On November 4, 1979, Iranian student activists stormed the U.S. embassy in Tehran, taking over 60 Americans hostage. What was planned as a 48-hour sit-in to protest American imperialism, ballooned into an international crisis and 24/7 media event that would last 444 days. With never-before-seen archival footage and revelatory new interviews with the American hostages and Iranian hostage-takers alike, the series is a gripping chronicle of one of the most dramatic international deadlocks in American history, a deep dive into the geo-political history that led to the crisis, and an exploration of the political fallout that reverberates today.
title: Hostages

overview: What happens when the one you commit to spend your life with, ends up taking it instead? Narrated by Academy Award® winner, Helen Hunt, Meet Marry Murder explores several US homicide cases of spouses insidiously killed by their partners. Each story is told by the family, friends, and colleagues who best knew them, and the investigators committed to finding out the truth of twisted lies. With chilling storylines of romance, betrayal and greed, detective intrigue, and more, Meet Marry Murder digs into relationships that have shockingly turned deadly. The series takes a deep dive into several cases and uncovers a world of scenarios that end in murder – from a husband who broadcasts his intent to kill his wife on YouTube, to a woman driven to commit murder for a life insurance payout, and a successful Louisiana attorney slain by the man she met after a car crash brought them together.
title: Meet Marry Murder

overview: Household names endure some of the harshest, most grueling challenges from the playbook of the actual Special Forces selection process. There are no votes, and no eliminations – just survival. These celebrities, who are so used to being in the spotlight, quickly learn the meaning of "no guts, no glory" – and no glam.
title: Special Forces: World's Toughest Test

overview: This timely documentary series will tell the definitive story of the legendary 1972 Canada-USSR Summit Series of Hockey upon its 50th anniversary and through a modern lens explore its legacy and lasting influence on Canadian national identity, framing it against the political and cultural climate of the times in both countries, and around the world. With never-before-seen 16mm archival footage restored in stunning 4k, and exclusive interviews with key players, Summit '72 will bring an unforgettable moment in Canadian history to life on screen as never seen before. Audiences will relive—or experience for the first time—the adrenaline-fuelled, edge-of-your-seat drama of one of the most monumental cultural proxy battles of the Cold War, and trace its many reverberations in the zeitgeist right up to the present day.
title: Summit '72

overview: The day after Christmas, Főmenü, Duna Televízíó's brand new gastronomy program, starts. Starting December 26, every Saturday from 5 p.m., Michelin-starred chef Tamás Széll and actor and director Zsolt Anger will prepare recipes for the viewers that are even better, and can be prepared at home. The two hosts will serve their guests mostly Hungarian dishes with a hint of rethinking. Of course, you can't miss such classics as blood sausage, stuffed cabbage or bacon lung, of course not in the usual form.
title: Főmenü

overview: Utopia based initially around a small group of people who find a rare manuscript of the same name. This leads the group to be targeted by a large organisation with little knowledge of the manuscript's relevance or importance.
title: Utopia

overview: Hitler the Junkie is a hard-hitting and in-depth special examines the medications Hitler was taking, how much he took and how often, and whether drugs played a role in his behavior and actions.

overview: Reality about people who can not cope with the dirt and the influx of unnecessary things at home.

overview: Three successful influencers each coach a follower as they narrow down a field of dating prospects, hoping to trade digital likes for real-life love.

overview: The world is consumed in a pandemic. New rules are established. In a disaster-simulated virtual space called The Zone, mankind is being tested. Jaeseok, Kwangsoo, and Yuri, who all lack in camaraderie and credibility, are sent into the space with the great mission and responsibility of representing all of mankind. The three members must survive four hours in the unknown filled with unexpected situations, traps, and temptations!
title: The Zone: Survival Mission

overview: It's time for a different set of school supplies - scissors, sewing machines and fabric! The new school year brings the freshman class of young designers in the inaugural season of Project Runway Junior (#ProjectRunwayJunior). This next generation of up-and-coming fashionistas, ages 13 to 17, will be mentored by Emmy® Award winner Tim Gunn who co-hosts alongside supermodel Hannah Davis. Kelly Osbourne, designer Christian Siriano and executive fashion editor at Cosmopolitan and Seventeen Magazine Aya Kanai, serve as judges to determine who will make the grade. Actress Bella Thorne joins panel as guest judge for the final challenge.

overview: Join us as we explore the planets most spectacular man made wonders from iconic buildings, monuments and landmarks, to forgotten cities and sacred sites.
title: World's Greatest Man Made Wonders

overview: Twelve players complete challenges while trying to identify the one among them who's sabotaging their missions in this reboot of the cult-classic series.

overview: Ninjas were a fixture of milestones in Japanese history, and even now they're taking on secret missions behind the curtain of Japanese society. Set in modern Japan, House of Ninjas tells the story of the Tawara family, the last ninja family that had abandoned its roots after a certain incident in the past, who must take on the greatest crisis in Japanese history that threatens to shake the nation to its core.
title: House of Ninjas

overview: The NFL Pile On will showcase funny and unexpected moments from across the league, from mic'd up players during pregame warmups to postgame press conference one-liners—everything from studio shows, social media, and fashion faux pas will be fair game. And, with full access to the NFL Films library of content, The NFL Pile On will also ensure that no epic fumble or comedic moment throughout the season-long NFL campaign goes unnoticed.
title: The NFL Pile On

overview: A new chapter opens in the life of Zeynep, a babysitter who dreams of living a luxurious life, after she accidentally gets a large amount of money.

overview: This mini show is about school students who live in Kazakhstan, and focuses on the relationships between them.

overview: Press Gang was a teen programme that followed the trials and tribulations of a group of teens setting up and running a young people's newspaper "The Junior Gazette". Egos clash, professional and personal feelings collide and lots of one-liners and "crazy" situations made this every teenage-plus person's top of the list viewing. Shown as a prime time children's programme it was actually ahead of it's time socially. With mature and occasionally controversial storylines it shaped a lot of it's viewers minds those few precious years.
title: Press Gang

overview: Four farmers from across the country embark on an adventure of a lifetime in the hopes of finding their future spouse. Women will leave behind the dating apps and pursuit of love in "the big city" in favor of classic American courtship. The farmers will take their group of daters to their farm and show them what it is really like to live as ranchers do.
title: Farmer Wants a Wife

overview: For years, Naidu has kept everyone under his ruthless rule, until his nephew, Gopi, decides to challenge him and bring down his empire of injustice.
title: Parampara

overview: Inspired by real-life events, Shoot-out at Alair is a 2020 ZEE5 Original Telugu crime thriller series starring Meka Srikanth and Prakash Raj in the lead. Akhtar kills a policeman every year on the day of the Mecca Masjid blasts. Soon, Akhtar is encountered. However, after several years, when a policeman gets killed on the same day, IG Praveen Chand suspects Akhtar's involvement. Is Akhtar still alive?
title: Shoot-out at Alair

overview: A bunch of youngsters from diverse backgrounds gets an offer letter from People. Later, they are shocked when a senior employee informs them that they will become permanent employees only if they fulfill certain conditions.

overview: Will the first love couples who broke up for different reasons still have feelings for each other after many years of reunion? Five pairs of men and women each came to their first love again with green memories, regrets and throbbing. Will they reunite with the first love of the year, or will they find a new fate here?
title: First Love, Again

overview: Devil's Peak follows talented but broken Detective Benny Griessel, who is tasked with tracking down a righteous vigilante killer whose crimes are capturing the imagination of the city. Benny and grieving father Thobela are brought into the orbit of trapped mother Christine, who is willing to do anything to achieve a better life for herself and her daughter, and the fates of these three characters become inextricably linked as the series builds to its explosive climax. Limited Series
title: Devil's Peak

overview: Two lifelong friends from Philadelphia pose as DEA agents to rob a country house, but the small-scale grift quickly becomes a matter of life and death. The friends soon unravel as they find one of the biggest narcotics corridors on the East Coast.

overview: Missing is a docuseries that uncovers the untold stories of people who vanished, bringing to light compelling cold cases that never received the attention they deserved. Missing seeks to correct that while uncovering clues that bring us closer to the truth.
title: Missing

overview: T-Bag began life as a simple educational adventure serial teaching children about letters, but the strength of its central characters and its quest-genre concept made it an extremely popular series, leading to over ten years of enchanting children's adventure. Developed by Grant Cathro and Lee Pressman , the series dealt with a young girl challenging the dominion of the nefariously powerful witch T-Bag in several wondrous fairy-tale lands that blended both fact and fiction, collecting several items across many "lands" of the world they were inhabiting, when all the items are successfully retrieved, they form a weapon that either banishes T-Bag from the realm completely or restores the balance of power.
title: T-Bag

overview: The secret of assemblyman Nam Joong-do who lived away from the world while hiding his past and his wife Kim Hye-joo comes out into the world, drawing the dilemma facing the couple.

overview: Da Jung used to be a sweet working mom, but as colorectal cancer strikes her, she gradually becomes unable to eat. Da Jung's husband, Chang Wook, has never cooked before, but he begins cooking to take care of his wife's health and meals. Chang Wook handpicks decent ingredients and tries to develop healthy recipes to make a precious meal for his ill wife. Although he may be clumsy sometimes, he begins to realize how to treasure the time cooking and having a meal together with his family.

overview: An action growth drama about Yun Shi Eun, a model student with grades belonging in the school's top 1%. He looks weak but he fights against numerous violence inside and outside of the school. It depicts a naturally weak boy in terms of appearance, overpowering a jungle-like school by using his brain, analytical power, and tools.

overview: A disaster-thriller that unfolds after a major earthquake hits a building where ransom bargaining for various reasons took place. It depicts the merciless struggle of human beings to survive in the chaos created by complete disconnection from the outside world.

overview: A story that digs into the truth of past unsolved cases through the heinous current events. It is predicting the birth of a more realistic and new crime thriller based on a rare event.

overview: Serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer confesses to his gruesome crimes in unguarded interviews, offering an unsettling view into a disturbed mind.

overview: Survivor's firsthand accounts and actual footage fuel this emotional docuseries about the deadly 2015 earthquake that shook Nepal.
title: Aftershock: Everest and the Nepal Earthquake

overview: Xia Tian, a furniture designer, meets the owner of the design company Xu Jie Hao, who was her ex-boyfriend. Fate brought them together again, forcing them to work on the same project. It would seem that once extinguished feelings flare up with even greater force, but what to do with real life? After all, Xia Tian has a fiance Guan Xin, whom she loves and respects. How to make a choice? How to distinguish true love in search of romance and not step on the same rake?
title: Discovery of Romance

overview: Pro at Cooking is a comedy-based cooking show produced by Dave Lee and Davin Lengyel. Each episode features an original recipe prepared by Dave with the help of his hawtie assistants.
title: Pro at Cooking

overview: A mysterious agency appeared in the phone application of an ordinary socially anxious girl Chi Xiao Yu. It makes ordering a new identity as easy as a takeaway! To fulfill her work task, Chi Xiao Yu used this opportunity to change her personality with food, but this leads to the fact that every time she runs into CEO Su Yang, who begins to be interested in her. But just when Xiao Yu finally decides to say goodbye to a lonely life, the image of the winner in Su Yang's life collapses.

overview: Satsu, a girl from a modest family, marries Kenta, a young man from a wealthy and respected family. She settles in the family's house, where she meets her father, Keiichi, a strict man, Mihoko, an unfriendly daughter-in-law, and Akito, an older brother. Although not everyone likes the union of Kanta and Satsu, father seems to have big plans for our heroine.
title: Yangotonaki Ichizoku

overview: Gen Shimura, a young man born and raised in Asakusa, downtown Tokyo, vows to defend his beloved home town from a series of inexplicable incidents that coincide with the redevelopment of the area.
title: Gaki Rock: Asakusa roku-ku ninjo monogatari
